simple.meaning: אֶבְיוֹן (ʼebyôwn) is a Hebrew object word meaning “destitute.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 23:6. The surrounding context includes family, Torah, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶבְיוֹן (H34) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אֶבְיוֹן (ʼebyôwn) / H34 is traced through Exodus 23:6, Exodus 23:11, Deuteronomy 15:4, Deuteronomy 15:7 with generated occurrence evidence.
